gold.user: As a developer, I want to retrieve a list of local incoming phone numbers associated with my Twilio account so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The API should return a JSON array of local incoming phone numbers, including details such as phone number, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a business owner, I want to purchase a new local phone number through the Twilio API so that I can establish a local presence for my customers.
gold.ideal: The API should accept parameters for the desired area code and return a JSON object containing the newly created local phone number details, including its SID and status.
